source: Ciais et al. (2026), doi:10.1126/science.adx8262, main Figure 2A and Supplement Figure S3
method: Manual reading of central markers in Poppler-rendered supplied PDFs. The 2019 reference is subtracted within each series. Coordinate-reading allowance is 2 pixels per marker, not posterior uncertainty.

figure_s3.definition: Open annual circles are the three-inversion mean signed OH sink, S=-Q, relative to 2010. Subtract the 2019 circle. Use the LEFT axis; the right growth-rate axis is offset by 20 Tg CH4 yr-1.
